hints.title: Which bracket must close first?
hints.body: When you see a closing bracket, which opening bracket is it allowed to match? Think about the most recent bracket that has not been closed yet.

hints.title: Last in, first out
hints.body: Keep a stack of opening brackets. A closing bracket must match the top of the stack. If the stack is empty or the top is the wrong type, the string is unbalanced.

hints.title: Push openers, pop closers
hints.body: Walk through the string once. Push every opening bracket. For every closing bracket, pop the stack and compare types. At the end, the stack must be empty; otherwise an opener was never closed.
